---
title: "Send Small, Say So"
---

::: {.quest-dialog}
**Prerequisites:** Spot the Mirage. **Objective:** hand work to collaborators, whether or not they use LLMs, without passing them your review burden.
**Time:** about 15 minutes. <span class="ao-badge">General practice, not a vendor claim. Team norms you agree locally override these defaults.</span>
:::

A reef is a community. When you use an agent, the cost of checking its output must not silently land on the next person. The **Review-leech** feeds on exactly that.

Four habits:

1. **Review it yourself first.** Read your own diff as if a stranger wrote it. If you cannot explain a line, it is not ready to send.
2. **Say so.** Tell reviewers which parts an LLM helped with. It tells them where to look hardest. Your team may set its own norm for how.
3. **Send small.** One idea per change, small enough to review in one sitting.
4. **Bring evidence.** Include the test, the command, or the check that shows it works.

These help reviewers who use LLMs and those who do not. A non-user should never have to learn a tool to review your work.

## Battle: the hand-off
